title: Deployment settings
description: The settings of one application's deployment of AlixAI (master plan 14.2): the top of the cascade for every tenant and user of that application. 'Deployment' here is per application: a token for application A can never read or write the deployment settings of application B (ADR-0016), and what the operator controls for the whole installation (approved profiles, retention and attachment ceilings, the runtime, external mode, data egress, credentials, budgets, the decision layer) is configuration and operator-only API, never a setting. The deployment level is where voice, attachments and history export are first allowed; the levels below can only keep or narrow that. Every member is optional (absent means the platform default) and the document is closed: a member that is not listed does not exist, and a document that names a forbidden one (a tool to enable, a scope, a confirmation switch, LocalAI administration, external or hybrid mode, egress, a credential, a budget, the decision layer) is refused whole and nothing is stored. The key (application) comes from the verified token, never from the body.

default_language.description: The language used when neither a user nor a tenant states one. Must be one the application's active package supports.

default_model_profile.description: The approved model and resource profile used when neither a user nor a tenant states one. Refused unless the operator approved it.

capabilities.description: Capabilities switched off for every tenant and user of the application. Narrowing only.

confirmation.description: Confirmation asked for everyone in addition to the platform's. Raising only.
